select ifnull(tcu.id, tc.id) as id, tc.table_name, tc.column_name, tc.column_type, tc.label, ifnull(tcu.width, tc.width) as width, tc.min_width, tc.fixed, tc.sortable, tc.show_overflow, tc.align, ifnull(tcu.visible, tc.visible) as visible, tc.render_type, ifnull(tcu.sequence, tc.sequence) as sequence, tc.remark, tcu.user_id
from table_column tc left join table_column_user_config tcu on tc.table_name = tcu.table_name and tc.column_name = tcu.column_name and tcu.user_id = #{userId} where tc.table_name = #{tableName} group by tc.table_name, tc.column_name
